name: Metalert, Inc.
summary: Metalert, Inc., founded in Los Angeles, California, in 2002 and formerly operating as GTX Corp until its rebranding in September 2022, is a global provider of personal location-based products and services. The company specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of solutions that leverage Global Positioning System (GPS), Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), and cellular platforms to enable real-time tracking of people, pets, and high-value assets. Among its innovative offerings is the GPS SmartSole, a wearable orthopedic insole providing GPS tracking, monitoring, and recovery for individuals susceptible to wandering due to conditions like Alzheimer's, dementia, or autism spectrum disorder. Complementing this, Metalert supplies the Sole Protector accessory. Other personal tracking devices include the Take Along Tracker 4G, a compact unit featuring tracking and SOS functionalities, and Take Along Friends & the Invisabelt, a GPS cellular tracking and monitoring solution tailored for young children and toddlers. Metalert also addresses business needs with VeriTap, an NFC tag and middleware application designed to streamline logistics and asset management within supply chains. Its software portfolio includes LOCiMOBILE, a suite of mobile applications that convert smartphones and tablets (such. as iPhones, iPads, and Android devices) into versatile real-time tracking devices, accessible through a dedicated tracking portal or any internet-enabled interface. Additionally, the company offers Track My Work Force, empowering employers to monitor the location of employees, drivers, and sales representatives via their mobile and wireless devices. Diversifying its product range, Metalert also provides protective medical equipment and supplies, such as masks, sanitizers, face shields, UV wands, various other devices, as well as rapid antibody and antigen test kits, and hearing-assisted technologies. The company’s clientele spans the consumer, enterprise, and military markets.
